description: Returns how a person's name (Latin letters, e.g. 'Emma', 'João') is written in Hangul, the Korean alphabet: the name itself spelled in Korean following Korea's official rules for foreign words (외래어 표기법), e.g. Emma → 엠마, Juliana → 줄리아나 (Brazilian Portuguese reading with language 'pt'). The result is a spelling of the name, not a Korean name. Also returns other common spellings and page links.

language.description: Reading and link language: en (English names), es (Spanish), pt (Brazilian Portuguese). Default en.

name.description: The first name in Latin letters, e.g. 'Emma'.

name: write_name_in_hangul
title: Write a name in Hangul
